svg.text: I757-M main board — power block and P3 communication terminals
View: facing the front panel, positions 1/2 at the top. Always follow the silkscreen on the board.
Both positions of a row are the same net
(ring in / ring out). Keep downstream loads small.
120 Ω across A/B at each bus end
120 Ω at both CAN bus ends
Ports 1/2 (isolated) for field and long runs; ports 3/4 and CAN1 for in-cabinet runs.
Never join GND_A / GND_B / GND_CA to the device GND — that defeats the isolation.
Every RS-485 port is software-selectable as Modbus master or slave.
